changes: Synthetic 29-example train and 14-example prompt-disjoint holdout, with tool/no-tool/answer categories.
PEFT LoRA CPU training script performs actual optimization and stores model state, step losses, detailed baseline/trained outputs, and scope flags.
Heretic 2.x experimental ablation config is distinct from capability fine tuning, with limited trials and KL/refusal objectives.
Independent same-holdout A/B evaluator for Heretic weight variant; no automatic model promotion.
Android pre-configuration matches safe read_only_json tool compatibility for text-based tool envelope rather than claiming native tool-calling.
No user private data, cloud credentials, chat transcripts, private vault notes or external services are inserted into training examples.
unknowns: Whether candidate trained weights improve held-out tool selection without general-answer regression.
Whether Heretic runs to completion and how modified weights compare with unmodified baseline.
Whether model conversion, Android ARM64 runtime, device memory and thermal limits pass native acceptance.
Whether exact combined variant T1+H1 can be evaluated under a controlled order-of-operations experiment.
Full external model and tool-license redistribution review.
ranked_next: Inspect real training run report and fix measured errors without relaxing holdout or reference-answer checks.
Inspect Heretic experimental job and evaluate exact modified weights on the unchanged held-out cases.
Choose between B0, T1, H1 or T1+H1 only after repeatable negative and positive controls; retain baseline if candidate fails.
Build ARM64 GGUF and native model runner only from the selected verified source; native Android app and actual-device smoke.
Complete independent rights, security and rollback qualification before promotion to Google Drive distribution.

biases_and_lenses.confirmation_bias: retain all baseline and failure receipts
biases_and_lenses.automation_bias: do not infer model quality from workflow success alone
biases_and_lenses.n_ality: separate tool reliability, answer accuracy, source identity, rights and Android native compatibility
biases_and_lenses.simplex: not applicable to Boolean release approval
biases_and_lenses.continuum: measure latency and thermal trends in a controlled later device experiment
biases_and_lenses.fuzzy: may rank user experience but cannot soften pass/fail controls

decision: Hold APK packaging and model promotion until train/heldout/Heretic and native device gates pass.
